# pve_node (Data Source)

Node facts for one cluster node. Reads four endpoints per refresh: `GET /nodes/{node}/status` (uptime), `GET /nodes/{node}/certificates/info` (certificates), `GET /nodes/{node}/vzdump/defaults` (vzdump_defaults), and `GET /nodes/{node}/version` (pve_version). Full runtime status (CPU, memory, root filesystem) is served by the separate `pve_node_status` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_node" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_pve_version" {
  value = data.pve_node.pve1.pve_version.version
}

output "pve1_certificate_fingerprints" {
  value = [for cert in data.pve_node.pve1.certificates : cert.fingerprint]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (Attributes List) Certificates installed on the node, in the order reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/certificates/info`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source; equals `node`.
- `pve_version` (Attributes) PVE version details of the node (`GET /nodes/{node}/version`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pve_version))
- `uptime` (Number) Node uptime in seconds, from `GET /nodes/{node}/status`.
- `vzdump_defaults` (Attributes) Effective vzdump defaults of the node (`GET /nodes/{node}/vzdump/defaults`). The `fleecing`, `performance`, and `prune_backups` fields arrive as PVE property strings on this endpoint and are surfaced verbatim. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vzdump_defaults))

<a id="nestedatt--certificates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificates`

Read-Only:

- `filename` (String) Certificate file name on the node (e.g. `pveproxy-ssl.pem`).
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint.
- `issuer` (String) Certificate issuer name.
- `not_after` (Number) Certificate's notAfter timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `not_before` (Number) Certificate's notBefore timestamp (UNIX epoch).
- `pem` (String) Certificate in PEM format.
- `public_key_bits` (Number) Certificate's public key size in bits.
- `public_key_type` (String) Certificate's public key algorithm (e.g. `rsa`).
- `san` (List of String) Certificate's SubjectAlternativeName entries.
- `subject` (String) Certificate subject name.


<a id="nestedatt--pve_version"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pve_version`

Read-Only:

- `release` (String) The current installed Proxmox VE release (e.g. `8.4`).
- `repoid` (String) The short git commit hash ID from which this version was built.
- `version` (String) The current installed pve-manager package version.


<a id="nestedatt--vzdump_defaults"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vzdump_defaults`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) Backup all known guest systems on this host.
- `bwlimit` (Number) I/O bandwidth limit in KiB/s.
- `compress` (String) Dump file compression. One of `0`, `1`, `gzip`, `lzo`, `zstd`.
- `dumpdir` (String) Directory the resulting files are written to.
- `exclude` (String) Comma-separated list of excluded guest IDs.
- `exclude_path` (List of String) Shell globs excluded from container backups.
- `fleecing` (String) Backup fleecing options as a PVE property string (e.g. `enabled=0,storage=local`).
- `ionice` (Number) IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler; between 0 and 8 (8 is idle priority).
- `lockwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait for the global lock in minutes.
- `mailnotification` (String) Deprecated by PVE: when a notification mail is sent. One of `always`, `failure`.
- `mailto` (String) Deprecated by PVE: comma-separated list of email addresses or users receiving notifications.
- `mode` (String) Backup mode. One of `snapshot`, `suspend`, `stop`.
- `node` (String) Node the defaults are scoped to, when configured.
- `notes_template` (String) Template string for generating notes for the backup(s).
- `notification_mode` (String) Which notification system to use. One of `auto`, `legacy-sendmail`, `notification-system`.
- `pbs_change_detection_mode` (String) PBS change detection mode for container backups. One of `legacy`, `data`, `metadata`.
- `performance` (String) Performance-related settings as a PVE property string (e.g. `max-workers=16,pbs-entries-max=1048576`).
- `pigz` (Number) pigz thread count for gzip compression.
- `pool` (String) Pool whose guest systems are backed up.
- `protected` (Boolean) Whether backup(s) are marked as protected.
- `prune_backups` (String) Retention options as a PVE property string (e.g. `keep-all=1,keep-last=3`).
- `quiet` (Boolean) Whether log output is suppressed on the node.
- `remove` (Boolean) Whether older backups are pruned according to `prune_backups`.
- `script` (String) Hook script used by vzdump.
- `stdexcludes` (Boolean) Whether temporary files and logs are excluded.
- `stop` (Boolean) Whether running backup jobs on this host are stopped.
- `stopwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait until a guest system is stopped in minutes.
- `storage` (String) Storage the resulting file is written to.
- `tmpdir` (String) Directory for temporary files.
- `vmid` (String) Comma-separated list of guest IDs to back up.
- `zstd` (Number) Zstd thread count (`0` means half of the available cores).
